name: GS Visibility
description: GS Visibility is an SEO team helping small businesses in Europe and Australia rank higher on Google with technical audits, on-page optimisation, local SEO and keyword research.

services.name: Technical SEO audit
services.blurb: Find the crawl, indexing, speed and structured-data problems holding your site back, and get them fixed.

services.name: On-page SEO & content optimisation
services.blurb: Titles, headings and copy rebuilt around the words your customers actually search with.

services.name: Local SEO & Google Business Profile
services.blurb: Show up in local results and maps in your country, where nearby customers start looking.

services.name: Keyword & competitor research
services.blurb: See what your competitors rank for that you don't, and turn the gap into a prioritised plan.
